changelog:
trpg-md-to-pdf 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill.
- Converts TRPG markdown files (rulebooks, scenarios, catalogs) to PDF format for player and GM use.
- Preserves original markdown formatting and embedded images/SVGs in the PDF output.
- Excludes irrelevant files such as specifications, notes, drafts, and briefing packages.
- Ensures proper Chinese font rendering and compatibility for print/tablet/mobile reading.
- Original .md files remain unchanged—PDFs are generated as additional outputs.
summary: Use this skill when converting TRPG markdown files (rulebooks, scenarios, catalogs) to PDF format. Triggers on: convert to PDF, export PDF, generate PDF, 轉PD...
